@graph.articleBody: You open Google Analytics and see visitors, pages and sources. What you do not see is the number you actually care about: how many people tried to reach you. A visitor who taps your phone number, fills in your form or opens WhatsApp is worth far more than one who reads a page and leaves. GA4 can show you those actions, but it does not hand them over in a tidy list. Some are measured with little effort, some need a tag setup, and one of them, a phone call, can only be measured as a click. This guide shows which is which, so you can set up the basics and stop guessing. Key Takeaways - In GA4, a conversion is now called a key event. You mark an event as a key event by clicking the star next to it in the Events list. - Enhanced measurement can record clicks to other websites and form interactions, and Google says you do not need to change your page code for outbound clicks. - For a form, the GA4 event built for the job is generate_lead, but recommended events are not sent automatically. - A tracked phone-number click is a click, not a completed call. The same logic applies to a WhatsApp button: a click is not a conversation. - After any change, test it and confirm it in the real-time reports before you trust it. What Is a Key Event in GA4? A key event is an event you tell GA4 is important to your business. It used to be called a conversion. mainEntity.name: What is a key event in GA4?

acceptedAnswer.text: A key event is an event you mark as important to your business. It replaced what GA4 used to call a conversion. You mark it with the star next to the event in the Events list under Admin.

Not completed calls. A tracked phone-number click records that someone tapped the number, not that the call connected. Google's own help page says the feature tracks clicks on your number, not actual phone calls.

mainEntity.name: Does GA4 track WhatsApp clicks automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cannot say that it does. Google's pages on enhanced measurement and outbound clicks do not mention WhatsApp. Tap your own button, watch the real-time report, and if nothing clear appears, set up a tag that sends an event.

mainEntity.name: How do I track form submissions in GA4?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check whether enhanced measurement records your form submission by submitting a test and watching the real-time report. If it does not, set up the recommended `generate_lead` event, which has to be implemented because recommended events are not sent automatically.

mainEntity.name: How long until a key event shows up in reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google says to allow up to 24 hours for it to show up in standard reports. Use the real-time report to confirm that the event fires.
